objective: Independently test CW-10 vertical workflow, Git/worktree safety, durable lifecycle, and evidence judgment.
required_tests: Use independent temporary Git repos and real worktrees to attack explicit commit/cwd validation, source dirty+untracked preservation, path confusion, preparation failure, and no push/merge/stash/reset/clean behavior.
Exercise approval/proceed/revision/scope mismatch and direct-worker request classification; scope expansion must never execute before new manager authority.
Exercise real shell success, nonzero failure, exit-0 criteria failure, missing/ambiguous logs, lifecycle unknown, and bounded cleanup; exit 0 alone must not become success.
Verify pause keeps termination/log collection but blocks new judgment/report; modification-needed report ends the instruction and never auto-returns without a new instruction.
Verify TASK/REPORT delivery ambiguity is durable and no automatic replay occurs.
constraints: Do not modify product code, worker tests, guide, workflow artifacts, or graphify.
Do not weaken worker tests; use bounded runtime and clean fixtures.
No shared repo commit/push/merge/stash/reset/clean and no Docker.
checks: Run all tests/workflow and dependency terminal/bridge/tasks tests.
Run actual host-shell/worktree runtime independently where safe.
